name: IC Power Converter — BGA
description: Integrated circuit power converter cluster featuring surface-mount BGA packages, with parts including LTM4668, LTM4668A, and LTM8063.
selection_hints: Prefer tier A parts such as LTM4668 or LTM4668A over tier B parts like LTM8063.
Select based on footprint requirements such as BGA-49 (6.25x6.25mm) or BGA-28 (4x6.25mm).
Ensure compatibility with 0.8mm pitch surface-mount BGA land patterns.
avoid_when: The board design requires package families other than BGA.
Surface-mount assembly or 0.8mm pitch BGA footprints are not supported.
Parts outside the LTM4668, LTM4668A, or LTM8063 group are required.
